summary: RPM International Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Thomas C. Gentile III to its Board of Directors effective April 20, 2026. Gentile is chairman, CEO and president of Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL) and brings extensive manufacturing and industrial operations experience. He will serve on the Compensation Committee and receive standard non-employee director compensation as disclosed in RPM's 2025 proxy statement. The filing does not involve any departure, forced change, or contested matter. This is a routine board appointment, not a special situation, as it represents a normal governance action rather than an event-driven catalyst.
